fields.v: Iterative cycle over specifications: proposal (lightweight spec enriched iteratively) -> apply (agent derives artefacts, suspends to consult on ambiguity) -> archive (verified spec committed; later changes reference it). Harness mechanisms: H1 context engineering, H2 persistent shared knowledge, H3 executable specifications, H4 N-version parallel agents (git worktrees), H5 normative specifications, H6 structured consultation, H7 evidence-backed acceptance, H8 graduated autonomy

fields.v: Framework not empirically validated; benefits are predictions; terms unstable; operational details will date quickly; evidence skews to web/SaaS/platform engineering, regulated and embedded domains unanalysed; no adoption or maturity model proposed. Risks: talent bifurcation, cultural fracture, cost spiral, specification drift, platform lock-in; SDD may be premature for exploratory work. Research agenda RA1-RA5: team dynamics, validation of interaction patterns, orchestration competences, adoption pathways, measurement frameworks
